scenario.description: One background market maker quoting three levels around a stepping fair value, and one noise taker sending crossing orders (runner models exsim::sim::bots).

parameters.name: spreadTicks
parameters.description: Half spread around the fair value.

parameters.name: fairValueStepIntervalNs
parameters.description: Interval between fair value random-walk steps.

parameters.name: fairValueStepTicks

parameters.name: crossTicks
parameters.description: Ticks through the touch for crossing orders.

parameters.name: limitOrderProbability
parameters.description: Probability an order is a resting limit order.

parameters.name: limitOrderLifetimeNs
parameters.description: Lifetime of a resting limit order.
